title: CKA Week 8 Mock Exam - 18 Questions, 120 Minutes
description: A timed mock exam: 18 questions drawn from every CKA domain, graded the way the platform grades - live cluster state and behavior. Target: finish within 120 minutes above the 66% pass mark.
scenario: Exam day rehearsal. One cluster, 18 questions, 2 hours. First 2 minutes: alias k, $do, $now, completion, vim. First command of every question: check your context. Skim everything, bank the quick wins, keep 10 minutes to verify with kubectl get and describe.
symptoms: Questions span all domains: workloads, RBAC, networking, storage, etcd, Helm, Kustomize, troubleshooting
One seeded deployment (fixme) is broken and must be repaired as part of the exam
An etcd helper is pre-seeded exactly like a control-plane node in the real exam
mission: Score above 66% (the CKA pass mark) within 120 minutes. Then review SOLUTION.md and log every miss in mistakes.md before sitting killer.sh.

hints.title: Exam protocol
hints.content: Minutes 0-2: alias k, $do, $now, completion, vim settings. First command of EVERY question: verify your context and namespace. Flag anything over 6 minutes and come back.

hints.title: Weight your time
hints.content: All questions are 10 points. The RBAC pair (9-10), the CronJob and the ConfigMap/Secret are fast wins - bank them before touching the etcd question.

hints.title: The seeded helpers
hints.content: etcd-helper (kube-system) is pre-seeded for the backup question; the ingress controller is pre-installed; fixme is your one troubleshooting question.

hints.title: Verify before submitting
hints.content: Keep 10 minutes at the end: kubectl get + describe every object you created. The checks grade live state and live traffic.

acceptance_criteria.description: Namespace exam created and set as the current-context namespace

ConfigMap exam-cm (KEY1=val1) and Secret exam-sec (PASS=topsecret) in exam
Service api-svc (80) exposes deploy api with ready endpoints
Node tainted exam=drain:NoSchedule; pod tol-pod tolerates it and runs

auth can-i: deployer SA CAN create deployments in exam
NetworkPolicy in exam: client cannot reach protected, DNS still works
Storage: PVC exam-pvc (1Gi, local-path) Bound and mounted in pod pvc-pod
etcd backup: snapshot copied to /root/exam-snap.db and verified
Helm release exam-rel installed in exam with replicaCount 2
Kustomize overlay applied: kust-web at 2 replicas on nginx:1.28 in exam
Ingress exam-ing: exam.example.com -> api-svc verified with curl
fixme repaired: 2 replicas of nginx:1.27 all Ready (was 0 replicas, broken image)
